prompt: Create a candid, photorealistic 1970s street photography scene in a busy New York City downtown avenue, shot vertically on 35mm color film. A smiling young woman stands centered on the sidewalk, looking directly into the camera with relaxed confidence, hands in her pockets. She has long feathered honey-blonde wavy hair with a center part, natural makeup, and a warm sun-kissed complexion. Dress her in authentic 1970s fashion: a rust-copper striped one-piece jumpsuit with a wide pointed collar, partially open neckline, long sleeves rolled at the forearms, matching high-waisted wide-leg pants, a thick fabric belt with a large square buckle, and a small dark brown leather crossbody pouch hanging at her hip. The background should feel like a real captured moment: tall office buildings, a city bus, yellow taxis, pedestrians in period clothing including bell-bottom jeans and leather jackets, and a bus stop sign, all slightly softened by depth of field. Use muted vintage film colors, natural overcast daylight, realistic grain, subtle motion blur in the crowd, imperfect framing, documentary-style composition, and authentic textures in fabric, leather, concrete, glass, and metal. Make it look like an unposed archival fashion snapshot from 1974, not a modern staged photo, with no text overlays, no watermark, no anachronistic objects, and no glossy editorial retouching.
